purpose: Teach: 技師/舗装/練り/降ろし/耐震/ドラッグ/併用/学位

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、お前、卒業後、本気で、絶対、技師、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — after graduation, I need you to pursue engineering seriously. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Weight behind each phrase. Not raised voice, but unmissable conviction. A man accustomed to being heard settling his expectation into the room.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、舗装、絶対、材料、絶対、研究、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm dedicating myself to pavement material research. Thank you for your confidence in me.
lines.style: Formal respect but genuine underneath. Steady pace. A young man proving he's absorbed what was asked of him, meeting it with gratitude rather than resentment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文、本気で、絶対、練り、絶対、上げろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — polish that thesis work. I want to see it finished properly.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. No wasting breath. The clarity of someone who knows exactly what needs doing and expects no excuses.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データ、本気で、絶対、降ろし、絶対、整理、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm organizing my experimental data carefully and thoroughly. I appreciate your guidance.
lines.style: Quiet competence in his tone. Each word carries the weight of someone taking the instruction seriously. Not rushed, not slow — precise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、本気で、絶対、耐震、絶対、構造、絶対、研究、絶対、続けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — keep going with that earthquake-resistant structure research. Don't stop.
lines.style: Low-key intensity. Not harsh, but adamant. The voice of someone who sees potential and will not let it be wasted.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新薬の、本気で、絶対、ドラッグ、絶対、相互作用、絶対、研究、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm actively researching drug interactions in new pharmaceutical compounds. Thank you for pushing me forward.
lines.style: Quick, eager-to-confirm energy. Slightly breathless. The tone of a student racing to show he's understood and is already moving.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、複数手法、本気で、絶対、併用、絶対、研究、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — apply multiple methodologies to your research. Test them together.
lines.style: Clinical, precise instruction. Spoken like someone accustomed to designing approaches. Not a suggestion — a directive with reasoning behind it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。博士、本気で、絶対、学位、絶対、申請、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving forward with my doctoral degree application. Thank you for believing in what I can become.
lines.style: Deeper resolve now. Less formality, more genuine. The young man has internalized the message and is speaking his own ambition back, not just the boss's.
